title: Downloads
intro: Books, comics and audiobooks saved on this device for reading without a connection.
offline: You're offline. Downloads still open; reading progress syncs when you're back online.
needsHttps: Downloads need a secure connection, and this page was opened over plain http://. {link} to download things for offline reading and listening.
unsupported: This browser can't store downloads (it needs Service Worker and Cache Storage support).
tiedToAccount: Downloads are tied to this browser and your account — signing out removes them.
removeConfirm: Remove "{title}" from this device? It stays in your library.
